constructorArgs.notes: vestStart_ = 0 means 'deploy block timestamp' (resolved on-chain). liquid_ must equal the LP seed (3,500,000e18). cliff 7776000 s = 90 days; duration 46656000 s = 540 days.

deployedBytecode.howToCheck: Lucifer has immutables, so the on-chain runtime code differs from this object at the listed byte offsets (each 32 bytes: treasury, mine, pyre, marks, vesting, treasuryLiquid, and the EIP-712 cached domain separator / chain id / address / name hash). To sanity-check an address: eth_getCode(addr), overwrite each [start, start+length) range with zero bytes, keccak256 the result and compare with keccak256 (the object here already has zeros in those ranges). Also verify eth_getCode length == deployedBytecodeLength.

lucifer.addressPrediction: CREATE address = keccak256(rlp([treasury, nonce]))[12:]; the wizard can show it before sending (viem getContractAddress / ethers getCreateAddress).
